test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '3'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/929619d08b1151eb84e5738d28d9742f54d87a1e3004464e5b9ae2de6af4da98.png]
solution:
**Explanation:**

When we compare the figures 1 and 3 we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cad5643896fb1843a626b42119de41ea2596b56e97ed6bfb9c1733766bdc34f9.png] 

We observe that, when we move the dice towards left such that 5 and 4 are visible we find that on the left we have 3 and on the right we have 1 which means they both are opposite to each other. So **1** is the number on the face opposite the face showing 3.

**Hence the correct answer is option 3.**
